source_of_truth: third_party/nanoowl/nanoowl/owl_predictor.py (this repo, verified by direct read), transformers.models.owlvit.modeling_owlvit.OwlViTForObjectDetection (installed package, google/owlvit-base-patch32 config read live on-device)

verified_config.note: num_patches_per_side/num_patches computed in OwlPredictor.__init__ as image_size//patch_size and its square; 24*24=576. Verified via _owl_get_image_size/_owl_get_patch_size in owl_predictor.py plus live model.config read on device.

image_branch.entry_point: OwlPredictor.encode_image_torch (third_party/nanoowl/nanoowl/owl_predictor.py, lines ~196-224) or encode_image_trt (delegates to TensorRT engine exported from the same torch graph via export_image_encoder_onnx)

steps.detail: OWL-ViT's own CLIP-style ViT-B/32 vision transformer. Input image tensor [B,3,768,768] (already patch-embedded+positional-encoded inside vision_model). Output last_hidden_state shape [B, 577, 768] (576 patch tokens + 1 CLS/class token, hidden_size=768).
LayerNorm applied to all 577 tokens (CLIP post-LN convention).

OWL-ViT-SPECIFIC STEP, NOT standard CLIP. The 576 patch tokens are element-wise multiplied by the broadcasted CLS token. This is how OWL-ViT injects a global-context signal into every per-patch (per-location) representation, which is required because detection needs a PER-PATCH embedding, not one whole-image embedding like CLIP classification uses.
Second LayerNorm (owlvit.layer_norm, distinct module from vision_model.post_layernorm), comment in source explicitly says '768 dim' confirming hidden size.

steps.op: pred_boxes = self.model.box_head(image_embeds); pred_boxes += self.box_bias; pred_boxes = torch.sigmoid(pred_boxes); pred_boxes = _owl_center_to_corners_format_torch(pred_boxes)
steps.detail: box_head is OwlViTBoxPredictionHead: Linear(768->768)+GELU+Linear(768->768)+GELU+Linear(768->4), applied per-patch-token (576 independent box predictions per image, one per patch location). box_bias is a precomputed additive bias per patch (see _owl_compute_box_bias) derived from each patch's normalized grid position -- this anchors each patch's regression to its own spatial location (an anchor-free, per-patch/anchor-point regression, conceptually similar to FCOS-style dense box regression). Output is (cx,cy,w,h) in sigmoid-normalized [0,1] logit-space then converted to xyxy corners.

Linear(768->512, bias=True). Projects each of the 576 per-patch representations into the SAME 512-d space as text_projection's output -- this is the actual cross-modal projection on the image side (there is no separate 'image_projection' module reused from CLIP global embedding; OWL-ViT's class_head.dense0 plays that role per-patch).

TWO SEPARATE Linear(768->1, bias=True) heads, ALSO per-patch (i.e. every one of the 576 image locations gets its OWN scalar shift and its OWN scalar scale -- these are NOT the single global CLIP temperature scalar). logit_scale is passed through ELU+1 (keeps it positive, similar role to CLIP's exp(logit_scale) but architecturally a learned per-location head, not a single learned scalar logit_scale.exp() parameter as in CLIP).

image_branch.engine_boundary: encode_image_trt runs steps 1-7 as ONE fused TensorRT engine (third_party/nanoowl/data/owlvit_image_encoder_patch32.engine, exported via export_image_encoder_onnx which wraps encode_image_torch verbatim in a TempModule and traces it -- so the TRT engine is provably the same computation graph, not a reimplementation).

steps.detail: HuggingFace OwlViTProcessor: CLIP-style BPE tokenizer + padding/truncation, produces input_ids and attention_mask.
steps.tensor_shape: input_ids: [N, L] where N=number of prompt strings, L=padded sequence length

steps.detail: Standard CLIP-style causal/bidirectional text transformer (OWL-ViT reuses CLIPTextModel architecture as owlvit.text_model). text_outputs[1] is the pooled output (representation at the EOS/last-token position after final LayerNorm), same pooling convention as CLIP.
Linear(512->512, no bias by default in CLIP-style text_projection) into the shared cross-modal space, matching image_class_embeds' 512-d output.

text_branch.cacheability: This branch depends ONLY on the prompt strings, not on the image. In-repo evidence: results/stage_e3_nanoowl_benchmark/text_cache_analysis.json shows cold (encode_text every call) vs warm (encode_text once, reused) timing differ by ~57ms/call -- this IS the E3-measured cost of re-running this exact 3-step branch per inference when not cached.

cross_modal_matching.note: This is where image_class_embeds [B,576,512] and text_embeds [N,512] are actually compared. Full equation derivation is in matching_equation.json / docs/vlm_algorithm_deep_dive.md section 6; this file records only the call sequence.

not_verified_from_source: The internal layer count / attention head count of vision_model and text_model transformer blocks were NOT independently re-derived from source in this stage (out of scope for Stage F's algorithm-flow focus); these are standard OWL-ViT-base-patch32 = CLIP ViT-B/32 configuration values available via model.config and are treated as HuggingFace-library-level facts, not re-verified operator by operator.
